'''2016 EGP Steve Kotson LS Rendezvous Point''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Kotson]] at [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Kotson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rendezvous Point|SE-L-rendezvouspoint-decipher-archive.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
